issues.title: Bureaucratic tells: bodies telegraph doom via procedural anomaly (design, Wed W-block)
issues.body:
## Concept

From `SEED_GOVERNANCE_NAMES_YESAND.md` (2026-07-27 WS-3a Fable yes-and pass over the governance-body name pools): governance bodies should telegraph rising doom through PROCEDURAL ANOMALY, never printed numbers -- the honest replacement for the "-N doom" fiction strings the ADR-0015 data strip is deleting this week. Examples drafted:

- "The Sunday Group met on a Tuesday."
- "The Interim Interim Standards Board has requested a third interim."
- "The Panel moved to a larger room."
- "The Tribunal of Last Resort's waiting list has shortened."

This is one design motion with the ADR-0015 strip, not a separate feature: we remove fake numbers from event fiction, and tells are the true theatre derived from real sim state that replaces them (feed presents sim state; nothing reads back -- doctrine-clean per ADR-0015's single-authority rule).

## What needs design

A threshold -> anomaly mapping: which sim thresholds (doom bands, `global_alarm`/`global_panic` crossings, `political_pressure` sign flips, body `independence`/`teeth` values per `SEED_GOVERNANCE_BODIES_NAMES.md`'s tier structure) map to which procedural anomalies, and how tells are selected/rotated per body so the device doesn't repeat predictably.

## Slot

Wednesday agenda candidate (W-3b), per the yes-and doc's closing question: "Does the Wednesday workshop get 'bureaucratic tells' as a named agenda line (it wants 30 minutes)?"

Related: ADR-0015, ADR-0018, #984.

issues.title: ADR-0015 M-ticket: risk_events re-author + rebalance (20 live fields) + #967 finance fix + political_pressure dead-write
issues.body:
## Context

ADR-0015 (no printed doom deltas) shipped its engine layer, but the data migration is incomplete. The 2026-07-27 WS-3a scout audit (day-log: `docs/game-design/WS3A_DAYLOG_2026-07-27.md`; full inventory captured in the day's scratchpad `ADR0015_STRIP_INVENTORY.md`) found the literal-doom-field surface splits into two buckets with very different risk:

- **INERT (46 fields, S-sized):** `core_events.json` (40) + `2017.json` (4) + `crisis.json` (2). Path: `Resources.add()` -> `state.doom += value` -> **CLOBBERED every resolve** by `state.doom = doom_system.current_doom` (turn_manager.gd). Delete/re-author here is a pure no-op on balance. This bucket is BACKLOGGED per Pip 2026-07-27 1134 and is handled separately (S ticket, precedes the ADR-0016 pack schema).
- **LIVE (20 fields, this ticket, M-sized):** `risk_events.json` `pools.*.effects.doom` fields. Path: `turn_manager.gd` -> `doom_system.add_event_doom(amount, "risk_%s")` -- **NOT clobbered**, actively integrated every risk fire. These are the ticket this issue tracks.

## What this ticket covers

**Re-author the 20 live `risk_events.json` fields** -- this is a genuine balance change, not a mechanical strip:

- Each `pools.*.effects.doom` field needs a stream mapping (overhang / alarm / panic / political_pressure) with magnitude re-tuned to preserve the existing severity curve. Needs a playtest/calibration pass, not a same-day mechanical edit.
- All 20 also carry `"(+N doom)"` message strings that need rewording post-re-author (the printed-delta fiction ADR-0015 exists to remove).
- Line-numbered inventory of every field lives in the day's scout report (`ADR0015_STRIP_INVENTORY.md`, WS-3a session).

**Fold in the #967 fix.** `finance_engine.gd`'s `desperation_payroll` financing offer calls `state.add_resources({"doom": -suppress})` -- the same clobbered inert sink -- and prints "Pulled the desperation lever: -N doom now," a player-facing promise that silently never fires. The already-correct sibling is `actions.gd`'s `desperation_lever` quick action, which routes to `safety_absorption` and omits the doom number; `finance_engine.gd` is the stale duplicate ADR-0015 missed. Fix in the same PR as the re-author (same silent-promise class, same review).

**Fix the `political_pressure` double-dead write.** `actions.gd` (lobby_government action, current line ~618) writes `state.political_pressure += doom_reduction * Balance.num(...)` directly, but this write is clobbered every tick by `doom_system.gd`'s recompute (`state.political_pressure = _snap(state.global_alarm - state.global_panic)`, current line ~245) -- AND `political_pressure` is read by no gate or damper anywhere in the tree. It is doubly dead: the direct write never survives the tick, and even if it did, nothing consumes the value. Either wire a real consumer (a gate/damper reading `political_pressure`) or remove the dead direct-write and route lobbying's effect through the alarm/panic balance it's actually meant to shift.

## Explicitly NOT in scope

A17 / #971 (doom.streams.action_* pricing) is **explicitly NOT in this ticket** -- it already shipped in PR #974.

## Disposition

BACKLOGGED per Pip 2026-07-27 1134 (this is the M-ticket half of the R1 split ruling; the S ticket -- 46 inert fields + guard tests -- is separate and precedes the pack-schema work).

Related: ADR-0015, #967, #971.

issues.title: Half-day workshop: audit mechanics deep-dive (next epoch) -- something amazing under the smell
issues.body:
## Pip's ruling (2026-07-27 1811, verbatim intent)
'Make a firm plan to revisit audit mechanics next epoch. I will accept them for now but want a half-day workshop scheduled for it soon because it smells a little and I think there is something amazing and uplifting under it.'

## Context
The 4-way founder-hours ruling (2026-07-27, review-by 2026-08-31) shipped audits with unassigned researchers' optimistic self-reporting as the first distortion source (reported vs actual progress landed in the T1 substrate, PR #981). Accepted as first-pass; the smell = audits currently check only one lie from one source, and the mechanic's ceiling (Celine's-law channels, manager distortion, internal-board attestation chains, trust-as-resource) is clearly higher than its floor.

## The ask
Schedule a HALF-DAY workshop inside the v0.14 epoch (target window: week of 2026-08-10, before the 2026-08-31 formal review) on: what does auditing FEEL like as a player verb; the full distortion-source roster (self-reports, managers, boards, external attestations); audits x internal-board independence (the capture dial); whether trust becomes a first-class resource.

## Inputs to have ready
- Playtest observations of reported-vs-actual in the wild (Thursday 07-30 onward)
- The 2026-08-31 review question already on record: did optimistic self-reporting + audits earn its complexity?
- LADDER_0011 T4 atoms (manager shields, Celine's law) + governance-tier seed (internal board as audit destination)

Related: ADR-0011, #613, #980, PR #981.

issues.title: Conference away-window: planning-forward allowed, operating-present forbidden (attention drain refinement)
issues.body:
## Pip's design instinct (2026-07-27 ~1720, verbatim capture -- he trusts this instinct and wants it preserved)
'If a conference goes over the end of a month, we still want the player to be able to plan the next month, we just don't want them to be able to reallocate or adjust the backlog of things that are in-flight, or deal as Operator with any break-in events -- which feels verrrry close to what's being proposed but with some subtle teasable distinction.'

## The distinction, teased
Being AWAY removes OPERATOR PRESENCE, not PLANNER MIND. You can write next month's plan on the plane; you cannot touch in-flight work or answer the door.
- ALLOWED while away: authoring the NEXT month's plan (forward allocation).
- FORBIDDEN while away: reallocating/adjusting the in-flight backlog; acting as Operator on break-in events/windows (current auto-IGNORE behavior stays).

## Current state (merged #979)
_consume_founder_capacity drains ALL attention and re-drains each fresh month that opens while away -- strictly harsher than the instinct wants (forbids planning-forward too). Survivable and deterministic; refinement is a scoped change to that ONE seam function.

## Routing
Lands naturally with the founder-hour TYPING lane (4-way ruling 2026-07-27, review-by 2026-08-31): planning-attention vs operator-presence is exactly the doors/approvals/reserve split arriving there. Implement the distinction as part of that lane, not as a hotfix.

Related: #979, ADR-0011, ADR-0014, the 2026-07-27 travel ruling.

issues.title: doom.streams.action_* Balance keys absent from defaults.json -- publish_paper alarm + safety_research absorption are zero-priced no-ops
issues.body:
## Summary
Found by the 2026-07-27 silent-promise audit. The ADR-0015 migration rewired action doom effects through Balance-priced streams (actions.gd comments attest), but the doom.streams.action_* keys were never added to godot/data/balance/defaults.json. Balance.num(key, 0.0) falls back to 0.0, so today:

- publish_paper's global_alarm bump = 0.0 (action_paper_alarm missing) -- yet godot/data/actions/core.json:44 still promises 'Publish research to reduce p(doom)'
- safety_research absorption = 0.0 (action_safety_absorb missing)
- audit_safety scrutiny = 0.0 (action_audit_absorb missing)
- lobby_government pressure scale (action_lobby_pressure) at least has an in-code default 0.5 but see the political_pressure dead-write finding

Core safety-vs-capability actions are mechanically hollow right now: the strategic spine (publish, safety research, audits) does not move the doom engine at all.

## Also stale
godot/data/actions/core.json descriptions were never updated post-migration: :44 publish_paper 'reduce p(doom)', :70 team_building 'reduce doom slightly' (actions.gd:508 deliberately dropped that effect).

## Fix
1. Price the streams: add doom.streams.action_* entries to defaults.json (balance decision -- candidate for the ADR-0015 M-ticket calibration pass alongside the 20 risk_events re-authors).
2. Align data/actions/*.json description copy with what actually fires.
3. Guard: a test asserting every Balance.num key referenced in actions.gd exists in defaults.json (missing-key = silent 0.0 is exactly how this slipped).

## Provenance
Silent-promise audit 2026-07-27. Related: #967, ADR-0015, #613 (the effort/research economy this hollows out).

issues.title: Six upgrades charge money for effects with zero implementing code (+ hire_ethicist unbacked claim)
issues.body:
## Summary
Found by the 2026-07-27 silent-promise audit (sibling hunt for #967, different root cause). upgrades.gd purchase_upgrade() charges real money and prints an effect claim, but a repo-wide grep for has_upgrade( shows only supply_automation is ever consumed (turn_manager.gd:335). Six upgrades are pure text:

- upgrade_computer 'Research actions now more effective!' (upgrades.gd:100) -- never read
- comfy_chairs 'Staff morale improved!' (:104) -- no morale field touched
- secure_cloud 'Research breakthroughs less risky!' (:108) -- never read
- accounting_software 'Cash flow tracking enabled!' (:112) -- no such tracking
- hpc_cluster: +20 compute fires, but 'research 25% more effective!' (:116) has no multiplier anywhere
- research_automation 'Research scales with compute!' (:120) -- no scaling code

Plus actions.gd:640-644 hire_ethicist: '+5 reputation' fires; 'improves safety research' has no backing state (in-code comment admits it).

## Why this is its own issue (not #967 / not ADR-0015 M-ticket)
No clobber, no wrong channel -- the effects were simply never wired. Player pays, nothing happens. Distinct root cause: unimplemented purchase copy.

## Fix pattern
Per upgrade: implement the claimed effect OR strip the claim from the message/description (the 'say only what fires' discipline). cat_adoption (upgrades.gd:122-127) is the in-file correct sibling (real has_cat flag + real global_alarm bump).

## Provenance
Silent-promise audit 2026-07-27 (~140 promises traced). Related: #967 (clobbered-sink parent), ADR-0015.

issues.title: finance_engine desperation_payroll promises '-N doom now' but writes to the clobbered inert sink (silently never fires)
issues.body:
## Summary
Found during the ADR-0015 strip inventory (2026-07-27). The desperation_payroll financing offer (finance_engine.gd:254-264, accept_offer -> factory == 'desperation_payroll') calls state.add_resources({"doom": -suppress}) at line 258 and tells the player 'Pulled the desperation lever: -N doom now; a SECRET liability is planted' (line 264).

That doom write goes through the INERT sink: Resources.add() -> state.doom += value, which is clobbered every resolve by state.doom = doom_system.current_doom (turn_manager.gd:657). The promised immediate doom suppression never survives a resolve -- a live, player-reachable promise that silently does nothing.

## The fix pattern already exists
actions.gd:392-399 ('desperation_lever' quick action) is the already-fixed sibling: it routes the suppression through safety_absorption and deliberately omits any doom number from its message. finance_engine.gd is the stale duplicate that ADR-0015's original sweep missed (it only covered godot/data/).

## Scope
- Route the offer's suppression through the systemic channel (mirror actions.gd:392-399).
- Reword the offer message honestly.
- Before/after check: accepting the offer must produce a measurable doom-trajectory difference across a resolve, not just a transient print.

## Provenance
ADR-0015 inventory scout; recommended to ride the M half of the split strip errand (46 inert fields = S ticket; 20 live risk_events re-authors + this = M ticket). Related: ADR-0015, #613 prep docs, WS3_FINISH_OR_DROP.md section 5.

issues.title: CI: sim tier silently red on every main run -- test_adversarial_ui_state 6 deterministic invariant violations
issues.body:
## Summary
The non-blocking Simulation Tests job has FAILED on (at least) the last 5 main-branch runs (30183575511 .. 30192093124, 2026-07-25 23:56Z .. 2026-07-26 07:02Z), byte-identical each time: 6 tests in godot/tests/unit/simulation/test_adversarial_ui_state.gd (the #886 adversarial dialog fuzzer), deterministic (seed 727272), same violation counts to the digit. Totals per run: Scripts 8, Tests 106, Passing 100, Failing 6, Asserts 923/929.

Because the job is non-blocking, the red is invisible in the overall green -- the same failure pattern the honest-CI work (#640) was meant to prevent, one tier up.

## The 6 failing tests (all dialog-stack invariants)
- test_every_dialog_kind_opens_and_closes_clean -- 2 violations
- test_event_firing_over_each_open_dialog_kind -- 3
- test_opening_each_dialog_kind_over_a_live_event_dialog -- 15
- test_same_frame_collision_event_then_ledger -- 3
- test_rapid_double_open_same_kind -- 2
- test_monkey_full_ops_seeded -- 2 (breaks at step 12)

## Reading
These look like REAL invariant violations of the known dual-source-of-truth modal-state class, i.e. the evidence trail for #877 (LIFO modal chokepoint), not test rot. The suite is doing its job; the process gap is that nothing surfaces the red.

## Asks
1. Triage each of the 6 against #877 scope: expected-pending-chokepoint (annotate/xfail with a pointer) vs independent bug (split out).
2. Add a cheap surfacing mechanism so non-blocking-red is seen (e.g. a scheduled summary or a badge/line in the PR pipeline summary), without making the tier blocking.

## Provenance
Found while verifying PR #960's sim-tier red (verdict: pre-existing, identical on main). Related: #886 (the suite), #877 (the fix), #640 (honest CI).

issues.title: fix(release): v0.13.1.json advertises 404 download URLs; align contact address
issues.body:
Two small release-metadata issues surfaced by the pdoom1-website session (lodged at Pip's direction — please comment back with what's already done / in flight).

## 1. Broken download URLs in `v0.13.1.json`

`v0.13.1.json`'s `downloads.windows` and `downloads.linux` point at `PDoom.exe` and `PDoom.x86_64` — both currently **404**. The real release assets are `PDoom-Windows-v0.13.1.zip` and `PDoom-Linux-v0.13.1.zip` (macOS `PDoom.app.zip` resolves fine). Anything consuming that JSON — an updater, a mirror, a launcher — breaks for Windows/Linux. Reconcile the JSON to the actual asset names, or rename the assets to match the JSON.

_The website itself is unaffected — it reads the live release asset list, not this JSON — but the metadata is internally inconsistent._

## 2. Contact address split

The v0.13.1 release body tells users to email `pip@beacongcr.org`; the entire website uses `team@pdoom1.com`. Pick one canonical address (or emit it as a field consumers can read) so feedback doesn't scatter across two inboxes.

---

issues.title: feat(engine): integrate frontier-labs dataset (pdoom-data#37); expose a list the website can pull to fix calculate-game-stats
issues.body:
## Ask (follow-on from pdoom-data#37)

Once pdoom-data ships its first-pass frontier-labs dataset (**PipFoweraker/pdoom-data#37** — foundation dates 2000→present), build the follow-on:

1. **Integrate** the frontier-labs list + foundation dates into the game engine (labs as timeline entities that come into existence on their founding dates).
2. **As soon as the MVP is enough for the website to consume it**, expose it so pdoom1-website can pull the list — so we can retire the hardcoded lab list in `calculate-game-stats.py` and drive `frontier_labs_count` (and future stats) from real data.

## Why

pdoom1-website currently hardcodes the frontier-labs list in `scripts/calculate-game-stats.py` to produce a stubbed count. Per the cross-repo protocol (game/data own truth; the website derives), that count should come from the canonical dataset. This also feeds the website's planned "state of doom" stats page.

## Sequencing (please don't block the website on full engine work)

`pdoom-data#37` → **engine integration** → **expose a consumable artifact**. The website does **not** need the full engine integration — it just needs a **stable, fetchable list** of `{id, name, founded, status}`. Please ship that consumable early (a served JSON, or simply point us at the pdoom-data serveable if that's cleaner) even if the richer engine timeline mechanics land later.

## Definition of done (for the website's needs)

- A documented, fetchable artifact of frontier labs + foundation dates.
- The URL + shape noted in a comment here so the pdoom1-website session can wire `calculate-game-stats.py` to it.

---
_Depends on pdoom-data#37. Filed as cross-repo work at Pip's direction (contact-protocol override, 2026-07-27) by the pdoom1-website session._

issues.title: design(hiring): W3 -- revisit the candidate pool cap (MAX_CANDIDATES=6); stale once networking changes, and cap-hits are partly silent
issues.body:
Pip ruling (2026-07-26): the candidate pool cap needs revisiting in W3 if not before -- the cap may be stale as the way networking/sourcing works changes.

## Current state: MAX_CANDIDATES = 6, and it bites in several places

- `game_state.gd:104` -- `const MAX_CANDIDATES: int = 6`, hardcoded (NOT Balance-sourced, unlike most hiring tunables).
- `game_state.gd:597 add_candidate` -- **silently drops** the candidate when the pool is full. No log, no event.
- `hiring_pipeline.gd:186 _add_sourced_candidate` -- returns false at cap. The connections path emits a `connection_pool_full` event (hiring_pipeline.gd:719), but the ADVERTISE path just skips the `advertise_hit` event: **paid campaign candidates are silently discarded at cap**. This is the same failure mode that got the old free per-turn refill removed (see the NOTE at the top of turn_manager.gd) -- sourcing spend competing with a tiny fixed pool.
- `turn_manager.gd _restore_stranded_hires` (PR #960) -- a stranded hire returning to a FULL pool "takes another offer" (visible, but still a loss driven by the cap).
- `hiring_panel_controller.gd:120` -- UI header renders `CANDIDATE POOL (n/6)`.

## Questions for W3

- Is a fixed cap even the right shape once networking changes, or should pool size scale with something (reputation, org size, sourcing investment, an upgrade)?
- If a cap stays: what happens at cap must NEVER be silent -- displacement (worst candidate leaves), refusal-with-message, or a queue, but not a silent drop.
- First step regardless of the design ruling: move the constant to Balance (`hiring.pool_cap` or similar) so it is tunable data, not a const.

Related: #830 (hiring statefulness), #833 (people-and-money cohesion spine), #954 (full candidate cards -- a bigger pool changes that UI's scale assumptions).
